hero.title: Analyze Your CV with AI in Seconds
hero.subtitle: As soon as you upload your CV, CVora AI reveals your strengths, weaknesses, missing skills, and improvement suggestions — strengthen your CV before you apply.
hero.hint: No credit card required — get started with the Free plan right away.

howItWorks.heading: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Body: Upload your CV in PDF or DOCX format.
howItWorks.step2Body: Get a detailed CV analysis within seconds.
howItWorks.step3Body: See your score, suggestions, and missing keywords.

benefits.heading: What You Get with CVora AI

objective.title: Objective Evaluation
objective.body: Have your CV evaluated with an unbiased score, from a recruiter's perspective.

concrete.title: Concrete Suggestions
concrete.body: Get improvement suggestions tailored to your CV, not generic advice.

keywords.title: Missing Keywords
keywords.body: See the missing skills that would help you stand out for the positions you apply to.

history.title: Your Past Analyses
history.body: Save all your analyses and track your progress over time.

security.heading: Security and Privacy
security.body: Your CV may contain personal and sensitive information. CVora AI only uses your CV content to produce the analysis, stores it tied to your authenticated account, and never shares it with any other user. Your payment details never reach this application — they are processed through Iyzico's secure payment infrastructure. See our {privacyLink} page for details.

q1.question: How does CVora AI analyze my CV?
q1.answer: After you upload your CV, the AI model reads its content and produces an overall score, strengths/weaknesses, a skill list, missing keywords, and concrete suggestions. Your CV file is only used to produce the analysis.

q2.question: What's the difference between Free and Premium?
q2.answer: The Free plan gives you 2 analyses per month. The Premium plan has no monthly analysis limit.

q3.question: Is my payment information safe?
q3.answer: Your card details never reach this application — payment is collected through Iyzico's own secure payment form. Premium is only activated based on a server-side-verified result from Iyzico.

q4.question: Can I delete my CV after analyzing it?
q4.answer: Yes. You can delete any CV and its analysis result at any time from your Analysis History page.

point1.title: AI-Powered Analysis
point1.body: An advanced language model reads your CV in seconds and evaluates it from a recruiter's perspective.

point2.title: Your Data Stays Safe
point2.body: Your CV content is used only to produce your analysis, stored tied to your account, and never shared with other users.

point3.title: Results in Minutes
point3.body: See your score and detailed feedback right after you upload — no waiting.

point4.title: A Constantly Improving Product
point4.body: Keep strengthening your CV with features like the Career Assistant, comparison, and analysis history alongside the core analysis.

careerInsights.heading: Career Insights
careerInsights.body: Go beyond a single analysis. Career Assistant evaluates your CV against the roles you're targeting and gives you concrete, personalized career recommendations.

point1.title: Rewrite Suggestions
point1.body: Get line-by-line suggestions to describe your experience more powerfully and effectively.

point2.title: Career Roadmap
point2.body: Learn which roles and skills to focus on next, based on your current experience.

point3.title: Personalized Cover Letter
point3.body: Generate a cover letter draft tailored to the role you're applying for, built from your CV.

scoring.heading: Detailed Resume Scoring
scoring.body: CVora Score doesn't just reduce your CV to a single number — it separately shows your strengths, the areas that need work, and a skills/experience/education breakdown.

point1.title: Overall Score
point1.body: See your CV's overall strength as a clear score out of 100.

point2.title: Strengths & Weaknesses
point2.body: See, side by side, what will catch a recruiter's eye and what might work against you.

point3.title: Skills, Experience & Education Breakdown
point3.body: Get each section of your CV evaluated on its own.

jobMatching.heading: Job & Career Recommendations
jobMatching.body: Career Assistant matches your CV against a target role — showing your fit and missing keywords — and points you toward the roles you're best suited for.

point1.title: Role Fit Analysis
point1.body: See how well your CV fits the job posting you're targeting.

point2.title: Missing Keywords
point2.body: Discover the missing skills and keywords that would help your application stand out.

finalCta.heading: Strengthen Your CV Today
finalCta.body: No credit card required. Start with the Free plan and get your first analysis in seconds.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how CVora AI (the "Application") collects, processes, and protects its users' personal data. Because documents like your CV may contain sensitive personal data (identity, contact, education, work history information), we prepared this document with care.
section1Items: Account information: your email address, and the irreversible (hashed) form of your password.
The CV file you upload and the text content extracted from it.
AI analysis results (score, strengths/weaknesses, suggestions, etc.).
If you upgrade to Premium: the payment provider Iyzico's transaction result and technical reference codes that are not personally identifying to you (your card details never reach this application).
Messages you send us through the contact form.
privacy.section2Heading: 2. Why Do We Process This Data?
section2Items: To create your account and verify your identity.
To analyze your CV and present you with a result.
To track your Free/Premium plan usage entitlement.
To carry out and verify the Premium payment process.
To respond to your contact requests.
privacy.section3Heading: 3. Who Is Your Data Shared With?
privacy.section3Body: Your CV content is sent to the AI provider for the purpose of producing the analysis. Your payment transactions are processed by Iyzico. Your data is not shared with or sold to third parties for marketing purposes, except where legally required.
privacy.section4Heading: 4. How Long Is Your Data Retained?
privacy.section4Body: Your data is retained as long as your account is active. When you delete a CV or an analysis, the corresponding record is permanently removed. Payment records may continue to be retained after account closure due to financial/administrative obligations.
privacy.section5Body: Under Turkish Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data ("KVKK"), you have the right to learn whether your data is being processed, to request information about it if so, to learn the purpose of processing, to know the third parties to whom it is transferred domestically or abroad, to request correction if it is processed incompletely or incorrectly, to request its deletion/destruction, and to object. You can reach us via our {contactLink} page to exercise these rights.
privacy.section6Body: You can close your account from your Account page. Once your account is closed, you will not be able to log in; your CV/analysis/payment records may continue to be kept in the system for a while longer due to data integrity and legal retention obligations.
privacy.section7Body: See our {cookiesLink} page for information about our use of cookies.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service explain the rules you must follow when using the CVora AI (the "Application") service. By using the Application, you are deemed to have accepted these terms.
terms.section1Body: CVora AI is a tool that analyzes the CV document you upload using AI and provides a score, suggestions, and feedback. The analysis results provided are a suggestion; they do not guarantee success in recruitment processes.
section2Items: You are responsible for keeping your account information (especially your password) confidential.
You are responsible for the actions carried out through your account.
You must only create an account with accurate information belonging to yourself.
terms.section3Body: The Free plan offers a limited number of analyses per month. The Premium plan offers unlimited monthly analyses and requires a subscription payment processed through Iyzico. You can cancel your Premium subscription at any time from your Account page.
section4Items: Using the Application to analyze documents belonging to others without permission.
Using the Application in a way that damages its infrastructure or places excessive load on it.
Attempting to reverse-engineer the service or gain unauthorized access.
terms.section5Body: Analysis results are generated by AI and absolute accuracy is not guaranteed. The Application cannot be held liable for damages arising from decisions made based on the analysis results (job applications, hiring, etc.).
terms.section6Body: These terms may be updated from time to time. Significant changes will be announced within the Application.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: CVora AI uses your browser's local storage (localStorage) to manage your session. This storage technically serves the same purpose as a cookie: it keeps your session active.
cookies.section1ItemBody: Stored in your browser's localStorage when you log in; used to verify your identity on every API request. Removed when you log out.
cookies.section1Note: We do not currently use third-party advertising/tracking cookies. Iyzico's payment form may use its own security and fraud-prevention cookies; these cookies are subject to Iyzico's own privacy policy.
cookies.section2Heading: 2. How Can You Control This Storage?
cookies.section2Body: You can clear your localStorage data at any time from your browser settings; doing so will automatically log you out of your session.
